verdict.rationale: Docs confirm REST/GraphQL APIs to programmatically manage products, orders, and store settings (bigcommerce-docs-30, bigcommerce-docs-25), which supports bulk catalog operations via API, but there is no explicit documentation of a native CSV bulk import/export tool for the catalog in this evidence pack, and one community report flags historical API reliability/throttling issues (bigcommerce-comm-4). missing for 10: explicit CSV import/export feature docs, UI walkthrough for bulk edit, independent confirmation of reliable bulk operations at scale.
